jsonPatch.expression:
object.spec.?containers.orValue([]).transformList(i, c,


  c.name == "ai-gateway-extproc" &&
  c.?args.orValue([]).exists(j, arg,
    j > 0 && arg == ":9856" && c.args[j - 1] == "-mcpAddr"),
  JSONPatch{
    op: "replace",
    path: "/spec/containers/" + string(i) + "/args",
    value: c.args.transformList(j, arg,
      j > 0 && arg == ":9856" && c.args[j - 1] == "-mcpAddr"
        ? "127.0.0.1:9856" : arg)
  })
